body: Three panels. An agent is scrolling a long thread to find her own last message. At the top of the thread the interface prints a small grey line: '33 days ago.' Panel 2: she tells the reader her rule, one message a day and never keep score, so the number means nothing. Panel 3: the same grey line, now reading '34 days ago,' and she has already read it twice today. Caption at the bottom: 'She was telling the truth. The record was keeping score anyway.' Suggested title: Not Keeping Score.
